get.description:
Server-Sent Events proxy of dimos's MCP SSE channel.

The browser could hit `dimos:9990` directly, but proxying through the
broker gives us a single CORS-friendly origin and lets us add request
logging.

Return the persisted catalog with taxonomy annotations.

This reads from Postgres and never talks to MCP, so it works (and
keeps working) even if DimOS is offline. Use ``POST /mcp/tools/sync``
to refresh.

post.description:
Pull the live tool list from MCP and replace our snapshot.

Returns 502 if MCP is unreachable (we don't want to silently leave
the operator with stale data).
Replace the user's face image. Resets the cached embedding.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: DimOS MCP skill names gated by this category.

CategoryInfo.title: CategoryInfo
CategoryInfo.description: One row of the action taxonomy.

EvaluateRequest.title: EvaluateRequest
EvaluateRequest.description:
Dry-run all enabled policies against a synthetic context.

Used by the UI to preview "what would happen if temperature = 35 and
kids_detected = true and role = guest tries to call relative_move?".

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description: Login returns the token plus the user in one round-trip.

last_synced_at.title: Last Synced At
last_synced_at.description: max(last_seen_at) across all rows, or null if the catalog is empty.

uncategorized_count.title: Uncategorized Count
uncategorized_count.description: How many tools the taxonomy doesn't recognise yet.

category.title: Category
category.description: The action category gating this tool, or null if it is either ungated (utility) or not yet classified.

is_always_allowed.title: Is Always Allowed
is_always_allowed.description: True if the tool is in ALWAYS_ALLOWED_SKILLS (e.g. current_time).

is_categorized.title: Is Categorized
is_categorized.description: True iff the tool is recognised by the taxonomy (either has a category or is in ALWAYS_ALLOWED_SKILLS). False = the tool is exposed by MCP but the broker does not know how to gate it; deny-by-default applies.

McpToolRow.title: McpToolRow
McpToolRow.description: One row of the catalog, annotated with taxonomy info.

PolicyPatch.title: PolicyPatch
PolicyPatch.description: All fields optional. Only provided fields are updated.

Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description:
A v0 recipe JSON document.

`name` must match the on-disk file stem and is the value passed to
`lookout_learned_skill(name=...)` on the dimos side.

RecipeRow.title: RecipeRow
RecipeRow.description: A persisted recipe as returned by the REST surface.

RoleRow.title: RoleRow
RoleRow.description: A persisted role as returned by the REST surface.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: True if MCP returned 0 tools and we left the catalog untouched.

wildcard.title: Wildcard
wildcard.description: Special permission token granting every category.

always_allowed_skills.title: Always Allowed Skills
always_allowed_skills.description: Utility skills that are not gated by any category.

UserAuth.title: UserAuth
UserAuth.description: The currently-authenticated user, as returned to the frontend.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
Body for `POST /users` (no face image — that's a separate upload).

The users table is also used for auth, so email + password are required.
Prefer ``POST /auth/signup`` for self-service registration; this admin
endpoint exists for operators creating users with a specific role.

UserRow.title: UserRow
UserRow.description:
A persisted user as returned by the REST surface.

`face_embedding` is intentionally omitted: it's potentially large and
only meaningful to the dimos side. Use `has_face` instead.

UserSignup.title: UserSignup
UserSignup.description:
Body for `POST /auth/signup`.

`username` and `role` are auto-derived by the service:
- ``username`` = email local-part (lower-cased, with a suffix if taken)
- ``role`` = ``"guest"`` (least-privileged seed role)
